title: Artificial Intelligence Engineer
description:
AI Engineer – Data & Automation (Healthcare SaaS)

About Us

AMX Healthcare is building a new SaaS platform to transform how healthcare staffing is managed—connecting clients, contractors, and job opportunities with speed and compliance. We’re investing in AI to streamline recruiting, automate data flows, and surface insights from our knowledge base (resumes, job descriptions, Confluence, ATS/CRM, etc.).

Role Overview

We’re hiring an AI Engineer – Data & Automation to design and build intelligent systems that bring structure, insight, and automation to our staffing workflows. You’ll turn unstructured data (resumes, job descriptions, documents, chats) into actionable intelligence using retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) , document intelligence , and structured extraction . This is a founding role to develop and own the AI function —defining architecture, best practices, and solutions that become foundational for our platform and business.

The Impact

  • Time-to-fill ↓ 30–50%: OCR → parse → validate → post cuts manual touches from hours to minutes.
  • Zero-drama compliance: Primary-source checks, expirations, and audit logs built in.
  • Revenue & margin ↑: Accurate pay-package math and cleaner timesheets reduce adjustments/write-offs.
  • Cash flow ↑: Invoice creation from approved time, automated AR, and payroll sync reduce DSO and billing errors.
  • Recruiter capacity ↑: AI SMS cadences and clean data flows speed shortlists and follow-through.
  • Decision speed: Live Sheets/Excel/Power BI replaces weekly spreadsheet marathons.
  • Platform rigor: MLOps, observability, and cost governance keep AI stable, safe, and affordable.

What You’ll Build

  • Document AI pipelines: OCR → classify → extract → validate → post for licenses, immunizations, I-9s, background checks, timesheets, and offers. Enforce strict JSON schemas, confidence scores, and text-span provenance.
  • Compliance automation: Primary-source license checks, date/format rules, name/DOB matching, immunization logic, and timesheet math (REG/OT).
  • Workflow integrations: Event-driven APIs/webhooks across Applicant Tracking Systems , healthcare compliance platforms , job boards , CRM/Marketing systems (e.g., HubSpot or Salesforce ), and Task Management Tools (e.g., Jira, Zoom Tasks).
  • Text message (SMS) automation: AI-assisted campaigns and cadences (opt-in, nurture, reactivation) triggered from ATS/CRM events; personalize copy, schedule sends, ingest replies/MMS docs, and auto-log to the system of record.
  • Comms → system of record: Integrate VoIP/SMS (e.g., RingCentral, TextUs, BeeTexting) with ATS/Compliance to auto-log activity, attach files, and trigger workflows.
  • Customer support & knowledge base automation: Zendesk + knowledge base workflows—AI triage/routing, macro suggestions, agent-assist via RAG with citations, chatbot deflection, and SLA dashboards.
  • Marketing & CMS automation: Content workflows with Jasper AI ; landing/job content in HubSpot CMS , Webflow , or WordPress .
  • Pay package automation: Bill rates + stipends + guaranteed hours → weekly packages with audit trails.
  • Finance, accounting & payroll automation (required): Integrations with QuickBooks Online or Xero and payroll tools to:
  • Generate invoices from approved time, bill rates, and contract terms; handle credits/adjustments.
  • Sync AR/AP, post journal entries, reconcile payments; surface exceptions for review.
  • Automate payroll prep from timesheets and pay packages; route exceptions to HITL queues with full auditability.
  • Knowledge assistants: RAG chatbots over Confluence/SharePoint/Drive/ATS/CRM with permissions, citations, and human-in-the-loop review.
  • Live reporting: Streams to Google Sheets , Excel , and Power BI for exceptions, credential heatmaps, ready-to-work rosters, AR aging, and payroll variance.

MLOps & Platform

  • Dataset/prompt/embedding versioning; golden test sets; offline/online evals; A/B tests.
  • CI/CD for data and models; rollbacks; feature flags; latency/reliability SLOs; canary/blue-green.
  • Durable orchestration and state (idempotency, retries/backoff, dead-letter handling).
  • Observability (traces/metrics/cost), drift detection, PII/HIPAA redaction, RBAC, audit logs.
  • Cost governance: token/throughput controls, caching/TTL, embedding reuse, batching, FinOps reporting.

Must-Have

  • Strong software engineering in Python and/or C# .
  • Hands-on LLM/RAG (embeddings, retrieval, prompt design, evaluation).
  • Document ingestion at scale (PDF/HTML/images), schema’d extraction, validation.
  • Secure, auditable data design ( HIPAA/PII ), APIs/webhooks, event-driven workflows.
  • Experience integrating enterprise systems (ATS/Compliance/Job Boards/ HubSpot / Salesforce ).
  • Experience integrating QuickBooks Online or Xero and payroll tools for automated invoicing/payroll with audit trails.
  • MLOps fundamentals: data/model versioning, CI/CD, monitoring, rollback.

Nice-to-Have

  • Healthcare staffing/credentialing domain.
  • Resume parsing APIs (Sovren, Textkernel, Affinda) or document intelligence services.
  • iPaaS/workflow tools (Zapier/Make), queues, human-in-the-loop review UIs.
  • Deploying AI apps on managed cloud (AKS/App Service or equivalents).
  • Information retrieval, knowledge graphs, or NLP research background.
  • Prior work on compliance-heavy systems (healthcare, finance, government).
  • Zendesk automation; Jasper AI content ops; CMS automation (HubSpot CMS, Webflow, WordPress).
  • Contributions to open-source AI/LLM frameworks or a strong portfolio of shipped AI projects.

Why AMX

  • Founding scope & ownership: Build the AI function—architecture, standards, roadmap.
  • Executive air cover: Direct line to the Head of Engineering; CEO-level sponsorship to ship.
  • Modern, open stack: Integrations across ATS, compliance, job boards, CRM/Marketing (HubSpot/Salesforce) , VoIP/SMS, CMS, accounting/payroll , and reporting—pick the best tool for the job.
  • Mission-critical outcomes: Help clinicians reach the bedside faster with fewer errors—visible impact on placements, revenue, compliance, cash conversion, and payroll accuracy.
  • Remote-first, pragmatic culture: Production over prototypes, HIPAA/PII first, human-in-the-loop where it matters.

EEO

AMX Healthcare is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome all qualified applicants regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

We move fast, take big swings, and care deeply about building a thoughtful employee experience. We are seeking an experienced and strategic HR Business Partner to join our dynamic team. In this role, you will act as a trusted advisor to business leaders, driving HR initiatives that support our company's growth, culture, and organizational effectiveness. You will play a critical role in aligning HR strategies with business objectives and ensuring our teams are empowered and engaged.

This role will be hybrid to our São Paulo office, which will require you in office 2-3 days per week.

In this role you'll:

  • Partner with senior leadership and management to develop and implement HR strategies that align with business goals.
  • Design and implement organizational structures that enhance efficiency and support business growth.
  • Coach and develop leaders to build strong leadership capabilities across the organization.
  • Provide expert guidance on organizational design, talent management, employee relations, and performance management.
  • Lead cross-functional projects and work in a matrix environment collaborating with global teams to drive HR initiatives.
  • Drive initiatives related to employee engagement, culture, and talent development.
  • Support leaders through change management, workforce planning, and capability development.
  • Analyze HR metrics and data to identify trends and recommend solutions.

title: English Language Specialist
description:
iMerit seeks detail-oriented and analytically minded Multimodal GenAI Evaluation Analysts to perform highly nuanced evaluations of AI system outputs across different modalities: text, image, video, and multimodal interactions. Analysts will assess the accuracy, appropriateness, quality, clarity, and cultural alignment of model outputs against complex guidelines, ensuring that results align with project standards and real-world use cases. These evaluations will directly inform the development and fine-tuning of advanced large language models (LLMs), vision models (LVMs), and multimodal AI systems.

Role Responsibilities:

  • Evaluate outputs generated by LLMs across multiple modalities (text, image captions, video descriptions, and multimodal prompts).
  • Assess quality against project-specific criteria such as correctness, coherence, completeness, style, cultural appropriateness, and safety.
  • Identify subtle errors, hallucinations, or biases in AI responses.
  • Apply domain expertise and logical reasoning to resolve ambiguous or unclear outputs.
  • Provide detailed written feedback, tagging, and scoring of outputs to ensure consistency across the evaluation team.
  • Escalate unclear cases and contribute to refining evaluation guidelines.
  • Collaborate with Project Managers and Quality Leads to meet accuracy, reliability, and turnaround benchmarks.

Skills & Competencies:

  • Strong critical reading, observational, and evaluative skills across different modalities.
  • Ability to articulate nuanced judgments with precision and clarity.
  • Excellent English comprehension (CEFR B2 or above); additional languages a plus.
  • Familiarity with LLMs, generative AI, and multimodal systems.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to apply guidelines consistently.
  • Awareness of cultural and linguistic nuances, including potential bias and harm in AI outputs.
  • Comfort with evolving workflows, rapid feedback cycles, and complex quality frameworks.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree/ diploma or equivalent educational qualification.
  • 1+ years of experience in data annotation, LLM evaluation, content moderation, or related AI/ML domains.
  • Demonstrated experience working with data annotation tools and software platforms.
  • Strong understanding of language and multimodal communication (instruction following in image generation, fact-checking, narrative coherence in video, etc.).
  • Ability to adapt quickly to changing project directions and fast-paced work environments.
  • Previous experience creating or annotating complex data specifically for Large Language Model (LLM) training.
  • Prior exposure to generative AI, prompt engineering, or LLM fine-tuning workflows is a plus.

While moderation of high-harm/high-risk material is not part of this role, candidates should be aware that occasional exposure to NSFW or otherwise sensitive content may occur due to imperfections in client-provided datasets. Applicants should indicate that they are comfortable working in environments where such incidental exposure is a possibility.

What We Offer:

  • Opportunities to shape the evaluation standards for next-generation multimodal AI systems.
  • Innovative and supportive global working environment.
  • Competitive compensation and flexible remote working arrangements.
  • Continuous learning and growth in applied AI evaluation.

Join iMerit to help shape the benchmarks and standards that ensure AI systems are accurate, safe, and culturally aware across text, vision, and multimodal applications. If rigorous analysis and innovation excite you, we encourage you to apply!

description:

At BT International, our purpose is to keep the world connected. With colleagues on the ground across the world and supporting customers wherever they need to operate, BT International offers a truly global experience. Whether it’s about providing cloud connectivity, helping organisations collaborate, or enabling innovation in cybersecurity and digital services, you’ll be part of a team that shapes how businesses succeed in a world that is being transformed by AI.

If you have the drive and ambition to make an impact on a global stage, BT International is where it happens

Why Technology?

We are in an incredibly competitive industry and it’s not just the technology that’s important, but the world of promise it creates for our customers. We live and work in a connected world where people want seamless service, great products and the best connectivity there is, as well as continually expecting more and more from us, and rightly so. Technology is BT’s powerhouse, with oTur expert technologists, we have a unique position in BT. By bringing together our technical and commercial expertise, and our insight and passion for customer experience, we help BT stand out from the competition. With the best networks and smart innovative products, combined with a personal experience, it sets us apart from the pack.

Innovation drives everything we’ve done since BT started in 1846. Coming up with new ideas and developing new technologies is central to our future. We want to improve people’s lives for the better in welcome, relevant and affordable ways and we’ll be fast to market with an effortless experience to match. We will continue to focus on developing our converged network capabilities which will give customers seamless connectivity. Our skilled people will lead this technological revolution, not only for our customers but for the industry across the Globe, truly making customers our heartbeat.

In Technology, we’re creating an inclusive working environment where people from all backgrounds can succeed. We value different perspectives, skills and experiences. We’re happy to consider ways of working that will mean you can perform at your best.

Why this job matters

• The purpose of the Network Planner role is to analyze the capacity based on take up trends, traffic flows and demand/adhoc requests from customers.

• Planner then initiates capacity augments based on the analysis.

• Optimize/rationalize network as required.

What I’ll be doing – your accountabilities

• Act as a SPOC and interface with suppliers in region (LATAM) for ordering, installation and troubleshooting as required.

• Capacity planning and capacity management of global network platforms in LATAM. Using multiple complex data sources from the live network and the CFU employing trend analysis to forecast port demand. Providing detailed solutions for the network delivery team to fulfil.

• Adress Process issues associated with deployed platforms

• Analyse bid requirements and provide technical answers.

• Service delivery support – work service delivery issue resolution, across build functions

• They may typically be involved in the build and configuration of network components of solutions working from detailed design documentation and work independently on small projects

Skills required for the job

• Mandatory fluent in communicating in English.

• Mandatory to have experience in interacting, and negotiating in situations involving multiple cultures.

• Mandatory to have a strong background in International Telecoms services and conventions.

• Desirable to have a strong knowledge of Global Telecoms regulatory environment.

  • Desirable to have financial Awareness and ability to manage budgets

• Desirable to have experience in Operational System Stack and especially in global netork inventory systems and tools.

• Desirable to have technical understanding of IP and SDWAN functions and configurations.

  • Atendimento ao Cliente : Mapear a jornada do cliente desde o pré ao pós-venda, suporte aos clientes e vendedores, desenvolver ações para aumentar a lealdade e satisfação do cliente, identificar oportunidades de melhoria, visando uma excelente experiência do cliente.
  • Alinhamentos de cadeia de abastecimento: Comunicação eficaz entre a cadeia de fornecimento e clientes.
  • Gerenciamento de Pedidos: Responder a perguntas, solucionar problemas e ajudar a garantir que os clientes estejam satisfeitos, garantindo todos os processos desde o recebimento do pedido, lançamento, atualizações até a finalização.
  • Atividades Administrativas Internas : gerenciamento da carteira de pedidos, fololow up com clientes, dominar os processos necessários para contribuir para o sucesso da operação/atendimento e interface com outras áreas da empresa e do cliente.

Requisitos obrigatórios :

  • Experiência com atendimento ao cliente.

Idiomas :

Local da Vaga: Salto/SP

Sobre a Stepan:

Fundada em 1932, a Stepan Company é uma importante fabricante de produtos químicos básicos e intermediários, incluindo surfactantes, polímeros, bem como ingredientes especiais que entram em produtos de consumo, domésticos e institucionais, como detergentes para roupas, xampus e limpadores de superfícies. A Stepan Company possui atualmente 20 fábricas globais e mais de 2.000 funcionários. Temos um forte histórico de crescimento. Nosso crescimento nos permite oferecer oportunidades de carreira significativas e estabilidade aos membros de nossa equipe. Temos grandes objetivos na Stepan e sabemos que cada membro da equipe será crucial para alcançar nossos objetivos. Independentemente da função, procuramos membros da equipe que tragam consigo uma mentalidade de crescimento, um espírito empreendedor e a capacidade de prosperar em um ambiente em evolução.

Celebramos a diversidade na Stepan e estamos comprometidos em criar um ambiente diversificado e inclusivo. Temos orgulho de ser um empregador de oportunidades iguais. Todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados para o emprego independentemente de raça, cor, religião, sexo, gênero, identidade ou expressão de gênero, orientação sexual, nacionalidade, informações genéticas, deficiência, idade, status de veterano ou qualquer outro status protegido pela lei aplicável.

title: Pessoa Analista Financeira Plena - Tempo determinado de 6 meses
description:
SOBRE ESTA POSIÇÃO - VAGA SOB PRAZO DETERMINADO DE 6 MESES

O objetivo principal desta posição é liderar o processo de controle de recebimento de subsídios/doações restritos, alinhados aos acordos de recebimento dos recursos, e liderar o processo de doações em conjunto com o departamento jurídico, bem como apoiar a Gerência Financeira com o planejamento e análise de dados financeiros, atuando transversalmente como parceira estratégica e contribuindo com a facilitação da comunicação de informações financeiras com as outras áreas da Organização, apoiando com a tomada de decisões orçamentárias.

PRINCIPAIS ATIVIDADES E/OU RESPONSABILIDADES:

  • Gerir e monitorar os processos de doações ou repasses de recursos financeiros para um terceiro/parceiro, assegurando que a doação seja declarada no sistema da SEFAZ, bem como o acompanhamento das prestações de contas pelos parceiros, se com encargos, alinhados aos objetivos institucionais do Greenpeace Brasil;
  • Apoiar a área de Grandes Doações e Fundações no controlar do recebimentos de subsídios/doações restritas, das diferentes fontes de recebimentos e garantir que todos os processos de controle, monitoramento e prestação de contas seja aplicado considerando a finalidade ou propósito da doação;
  • Apoiar a Gerência Financeira trimestralmente (por meio dos relatórios trimestrais), com os processos de construção e revisão de orçamentos com as outras áreas da Organização;
  • Realizar abertura de centros de custos e códigos de fonte de financiamento quando necessário e assegurar que todos os passos foram cumpridos;
  • Apoiar a Gerência Financeira com a criação e manutenção de dashboards financeiros;
  • Controlar e manter os relatórios e indicadores que lhe competem, gerindo as informações para melhorias internas de acordo com os valores e necessidades da organização;
  • Contribuir com a estabilidade econômico-financeira da Organização, apoiando estrategicamente os Gestores de Orçamentos de áreas/projetos no acompanhamento da execução do orçamento (realizado x orçado), para que os recursos sejam usados de forma responsável.

Inglês - Intermediário.

Obrigatórias:

  • Pacote Office;

  • Experiência com ERP;
  • Conhecimento em Contabilidade, Financeiro e Planejamento orçamentário.

Pós-graduação na área.

title: GIS Python Developer
description:
GIS Python Developer (QA/QC Automation – ArcGIS Workflow Manager)

Location: 100% Remote

Type: Full-Time / Contract

About the Role

We are looking for a GIS Python Developer to design, develop, and implement automated Quality Assurance and Quality Control (QA/QC) processes for spatial data. The role involves writing Python scripts (primarily using ArcPy or the ArcGIS API for Python ) and integrating them into Esri’s ArcGIS Workflow Manager to streamline and automate GIS data validation across teams.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop QA/QC Scripts:
  • Create and maintain Python scripts to automatically identify and correct spatial data issues such as:
  • Missing or invalid geometry
  • Polygon overlaps or gaps
  • Attribute inconsistencies
  • Coordinate system mismatches
  • Topology and connectivity errors (e.g., roads not connecting properly)
  • Integrate with ArcGIS Workflow Manager:
  • Configure and embed QA/QC scripts as automated steps within ArcGIS Workflow Manager task sequences, enabling:
  • Automatic validation after data edits or updates
  • Flagging and reporting of errors for correction
  • Consistent enforcement of spatial data quality standards
  • Ensure Data Integrity and Compliance:
  • Maintain accuracy, consistency, and traceability of all GIS data edits and updates across the enterprise environment.
  • Collaborate Across Teams:
  • Work closely with GIS analysts, database administrators, and developers to ensure smooth integration, performance optimization, and scalability of QA/QC solutions.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Geographic Information Systems (GIS), Computer Science, Geomatics , or a related field.
  • Proven experience in Python scripting for GIS automation .
  • Strong knowledge of Esri technologies , including ArcGIS Pro, ArcGIS Enterprise , and ArcGIS Workflow Manager .
  • Experience with ArcPy and/or the ArcGIS API for Python .
  • Understanding of spatial data models, topology rules, and coordinate systems .
  • Familiarity with data quality management principles (QA/QC) in GIS environments.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to work in a collaborative environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with versioned geodatabases (ArcSDE) and enterprise data workflows.
  • Exposure to SQL and spatial database management.
  • Knowledge of automation frameworks or DevOps practices within GIS.

What You’ll Achieve

You’ll play a key role in building a repeatable, automated, and auditable quality-control process for spatial data—ensuring every dataset and map product meets enterprise accuracy standards before publication or approval.

title: Analista Fiscal Júnior
description:

Fundada em 1953, a Barentz opera em mais de 70 países, com forte presença na Europa e na América do Norte e uma rede em rápido crescimento na América Latina e na Ásia-Pacífico. Com um volume de negócios de 2,5 mil milhões de euros, a empresa emprega mais de 2.500 pessoas em todo o mundo e serve mais de 25.000 clientes. Para mais informações visite nosso site: .

title: Global Demand Planner
description:
SWM International is a multinational company specialized in producing paper for the tobacco industry and solutions in specialty papers. We are expert manufacturers of a variety of advanced materials that are part of people’s everyday lives. We contribute to our customers’ success by delivering high-quality products and collaborating to provide innovative and customized solutions that enhance the value of their offerings.

Now, we invite you to be part of our daily journey, where each employee is essential to the success of our company.

Bring your talent to SWM!

We are currently looking for a Global Demand Planner to join our team in a permanent position at our São Paulo office (South Zone) .

Position Objective

The Global Demand Planner is responsible for leading the demand planning process across regions and business units to ensure accurate forecasts, optimize inventory, and align supply with market demand. This role collaborates cross-functionally with Sales, Marketing, Finance, and Supply Chain teams to deliver a reliable demand signal that supports business objectives and customer satisfaction.

Your challenges will include:

  1. Develop, maintain, and communicate the global demand forecast at multiple levels of aggregation (product, category, region, customer).
  2. Lead monthly demand planning cycles, including forecast reviews, consensus meetings, and alignment with key stakeholders.
  3. Analyze historical sales data, market trends, promotional activities, and business intelligence to refine forecasts.
  4. Drive continuous improvement in forecast accuracy and bias reduction through advanced planning tools, statistical models, and process enhancements.
  5. Provide insights to senior management on demand trends, risks, and opportunities, enabling data-driven decision-making.
  6. Ensure alignment of the demand plan with financial targets and strategic objectives.
  7. Act as key user for ERP and demand planning systems, supporting enhancements, testing, and best practice adoption.
  8. Prepare and present reports, KPIs, and dashboards to track forecast performance and process effectiveness.

What we’re looking for:

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Business Administration, Economics, or related field (Master’s degree is a plus).
  • Experience: Solid experience in the role, preferably in multinational environments.
  • Technical Skills: Advanced Excel and proficiency in data visualization tools (Power BI, Tableau, etc.).
  • Languages: Advanced English (French is a plus).
  • Availability to travel.

What we offer:

  • Family Health Plan (national coverage, employee contribution)
  • Family Dental Plan (national coverage)
  • Food Allowance Card: R$450.00
  • Meal Card
  • Eye Care Assistance (reimbursement up to R$544.00 per year)

  • School Supplies Kit (R$158.00 for children up to 21 years old enrolled in elementary to high school/technical education)
  • Christmas Card: R$370.00

title: Session Border Controller SR (100% remoto)
description:
Se você busca uma oportunidade na área de Tecnologia da Informação, tem organização, boa comunicação e vontade de crescer, essa vaga 100% remoto e CLT, pode ser para você.

Requisitos Técnicos:

  • Experiência sólida com Session Border Controller;
  • Experiência com Cisco, Mitel, Avaya, etc ;
  • Experiência com Protocolos: SIP, RTP, TCP, UDP ;
  • Idioma Inglês Avançado (terá inteirações internacionais).

Responsabilidades:

Como Session Border Controller Sênior, o profissional será responsável por projetar, configurar, implantar e manter soluções avançadas de SBC, garantindo comunicação de voz/vídeo segura, interoperável e com alta disponibilidade. Atuará com equipamentos como Cisco, Mitel, Avaya (ou equivalentes), sendo capaz de configurar e otimizar regras de sinalização (SIP) e fluxos de mídia (RTP), ajustar parâmetros de transporte TCP/UDP, implementar e gerenciar políticas de segurança para proteger contra ameaças como DoS/DDoS, fraude em chamadas e intercepções. Será responsável por assegurar a interoperabilidade entre diferentes protocolos e codecs, bem como a integração de SBC com outros componentes de rede e telecomunicações, como redes internas, operadoras externas, NATs, firewalls e VPNs. Deverá monitorar e otimizar a qualidade de serviço (QoS), latência, jitter, perda de pacotes, bem como realizar troubleshooting de incidentes, fazer auditorias de tráfego/comunicação, propor melhorias e atualizações, e garantir que os sistemas estejam alinhados com normas e compliance aplicáveis. Trabalhará colaborativamente com equipes de voz, redes, segurança e operações, influenciando decisões de arquitetura, definindo padrões de configuração, documentando processos e participando da sustentação contínua das operações

O que oferecemos:

  • Ambiente colaborativo e multicultural.
  • Oportunidade de desenvolvimento profissional em uma das líderes globais em tecnologia.
  • Pacote de benefícios completo CLT - PLR, VR, Previdência, Gympass, Convênio médico e Odonto e etc.

title: Network Security Specialist, Enterprise Browser
description:
Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks® everything starts and ends with our mission:

Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life. Our vision is a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we’re looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.

Who We Are

This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters. Job Description

Your Career

You will join an exciting and high growth business unit with Palo Alto Networks positioning the industry’s most comprehensive SASE security platform, with the industry’s broadest security and compliance coverage for applications used by your hybrid workforce, regardless of whether they are at home, on the go, or in the office.

In this role, you will be responsible for managing a territory focusing on Major, Strategic, and Enterprise Accounts. Working closely with Palo Alto business partners and driving sales for our Enterprise Browser security solution, into new and existing customers. It is expected that you deliver or exceed your sales targets in both new business and renewals for ACV and TCV bookings. The role expects you to define your territory, strategies and then lead local execution and in alignment to company strategies and tactics within the Prisma SASE organization.

Your Impact

  • Win new logos, renew existing customer and expand business within your territory
  • Achieve ACV sales quotas on a monthly and quarterly basis
  • Present regular/accurate forecasting for review
  • Track and report on all opportunities, pipeline, and bookings to provide forecast reports to region management
  • Establish relationships and engage with the local reseller and alliance partners on sales programs and joint activities
  • Develop, share and implement standard methodologies and account strategies to increase our sales penetration of Enterprise Browser into our top accounts
  • Engage with customers to identify and progress opportunities whilst delivering subject matter expertise on Enterprise Browser solutions
  • Qualify and progress leads and opportunities through the sales cycle to closure
  • Keep up-to-date knowledge of Enterprise Browser and other browser technologies as well as the competitive position of the company
  • Conduct consistent training and communications for the sales and channel teams as well as joint engagement within the wider organization
  • Contribute to the larger Palo Alto Network’s Prisma SASE strategy by providing regional specific intelligence and reporting
  • Apply subject matter expertise in training, QBRs, enablement, and other engagement activities
  • Gather “Voice of Customer” and competitive intelligence and share with theater and global Prisma SASE organization
  • Help build and project Palo Alto Networks position
Qualifications

Your Experience

  • 4+ years' experience exceeding sales quota as Account Manager, or Territory Account Manager for a multinational company
  • Sales excellence - ability to demonstrate planning, strategy, qualification and execution
  • Prior experience selling SAAS or Cybersecurity network solutions
  • Existing relationships within the region, including top accounts and reseller partners
  • Excellent communication skills including strong verbal and written skills and proven presentation skills being able to articulate complex topics
  • Experience with target account selling, solution selling, and consultative sales techniques
Additional Information

The Team

Palo Alto Networks has brought technology to the market that is reshaping the cybersecurity threat and protection landscape. Our ability to protect digital transactions is limited only by our ability to establish relationships with our potential customers and help them understand how our products can protect their environments. This is where our sales teams come in. Our sales team members work together with large organizations to keep their digital information safe. title: Contact Center Executive - Customer Service
description:
About Us:

HBX Group is the world’s leading technology partner, connecting and empowering the world of travel. We’re game-changers, disruptors, the people who bring together local and global brands in accommodation, transport, activities and payments through our network of 300,000 hotels worldwide, 60,000 hard to reach high value clients such as tour operators, travel agents and loyalty schemes across 140 source markets. We are tech-driven, with a customer-first philosophy, and commercial teams whose knowledge and relationships on the ground are second to none. And of course we have an amazing team! In fact, we believe that it is tech + data + people that truly sets us apart in the market, alongside our ‘global approach, local touch’ mentality. We are seeking a Global Contact Center Executive to join our dynamic Contact Center team.   • Consistent focus and enthusiasm throughout the work shift.

If you are passionate about customer service, communication, and creative problem-solving, we encourage you to apply today!

Note: Only candidates currently living in Jundiaí will be considered for this position in the Hybrid Model.

At HBX Group, we believe that diversity drives innovation and makes travel a force for good. We're committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and respected, embracing different backgrounds, perspectives and talents. Join us and be part of a team where diversity and equal opportunities really do make a difference

description:
Clinical Site Manager – (Ophthalmology & Neurology Focus)

Location: Remote-based

We’re partnering with a global biopharmaceutical company dedicated to advancing treatments in Ophthalmology, Neurology , and other complex therapeutic areas. To support several ongoing and upcoming studies, we are seeking a Clinical Site Manager to oversee key investigator sites across LATAM .

This position is offering a unique opportunity to blend operational oversight with strong relationship management at the site level.

Key Responsibilities

  • Serve as the primary sponsor contact for assigned sites and CRO monitors, ensuring high-quality communication and collaboration.
  • Oversee site management activities across multiple studies, including start-up, monitoring, and close-out phases.
  • Drive patient recruitment and retention initiatives, fostering engagement with Principal Investigators and site coordinators.
  • Provide operational oversight of CRO CRAs to ensure adherence to protocol, timelines, and quality standards.
  • Support the sponsor’s clinical operations alignment , ensuring consistency and excellence in study execution.
  • Troubleshoot operational challenges and proactively address site-level issues to maintain study momentum.
  • Ensure proper management of study supplies, documentation, and compliance with GCP and sponsor SOPs.

Requirements

  • Proven experience as a Lead CRA , Senior CRA , or Clinical Site Manager with strong independent monitoring and site leadership skills.
  • Therapeutic experience in Ophthalmology and/or Neurology is essential.
  • Additional experience in Immunology, Rare Diseases, or Respiratory indications would be advantageous.
  • Solid understanding of GCP , ICH Guidelines , and regional regulatory requirements across Eastern Europe.
  • Excellent communication, relationship management, and problem-solving skills.
  • Willingness to travel across assigned countries as required.

Why Join?

  • Play a pivotal role in advancing innovative treatments that make a meaningful difference to patients’ lives.
  • Work in a hands-on, strategic role bridging sponsor oversight and site engagement.
  • Join an international, science-driven environment with opportunities for professional growth.

title: Senior Cloud Data Engineer
description:
RESUMES IN ENGLISH PLEASE

JOB SUMMARY

The Senior Cloud Data Engineer leads the design, architecture, and implementation of secure, scalable data solutions on AWS, utilizing Snowflake, dbt, and modern automation tools. This role drives best practices for data quality, validation, and governance, while optimizing performance and reliability across both cloud and legacy platforms. The Senior Cloud Data Engineer collaborates closely with cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into robust data pipelines and products, mentor junior engineers, and champions continuous improvement in engineering standards and operational excellence.

DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Leads the design, development, and maintenance of highly scalable, secure, and resilient data pipelines and systems on cloud platforms.
  • Architects and implements advanced data integration solutions to support complex analytics, business intelligence, and enterprise reporting needs.
  • Collaborates with cross-functional teams, including data scientists, business analysts, product owners, and application engineers—to understand and deliver on evolving data requirements.
  • Ensures the highest standards of data quality, integrity, and security through comprehensive testing, validation, and robust governance practices.
  • Monitors, optimizes, and scales data workflows to achieve performance, reliability, and cost-efficiency targets across both cloud and legacy environments.
  • Proactively identifies, investigates, and resolves data-related issues, providing technical leadership, mentorship, and guidance to junior team members.
  • Champions continuous improvement by staying current with industry trends, emerging technologies, best practices, and by driving innovation in data engineering processes and solutions.
  • Partners with enterprise architecture and data governance teams to define and enforce data standards and compliance requirements.
  • Leads design reviews and technical workshops to uplevel engineering practices across the organization.
  • Contributes to strategic planning for data platform evolution and modernization initiatives.

QUALIFICATIONS

DEGREE TYPE: Bachelor's Degree

FIELD(S) OF STUDY:

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, or other related field of study; or any combination of relevant work experience and education

EXPERIENCE

  • Minimum of 7 years of progressive experience in data engineering, with a strong emphasis on designing and implementing cloud-based solutions.
  • Advanced proficiency in SQL, with hands-on experience in both relational (e.g., Oracle, SQL Server, MySQL, Snowflake) and NoSQL (e.g., MongoDB, DynamoDB) databases.
  • Extensive experience architecting and operating data platforms on AWS and Azure; relevant cloud certifications (e.g., AWS Certified Data Analytics, Azure Data Engineer Associate) strongly preferred.
  • Deep knowledge of data warehousing concepts, ETL/ELT processes, data modeling, and enterprise data governance frameworks.
  • Demonstrated success in leading and mentoring data engineering teams, driving technical excellence and fostering collaborative environments.
  • Exceptional problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work independently and proactively in fast-paced settings.
  • Outstanding communication, leadership, and cross-functional collaboration abilities, with a proven track record of partnering with business and technical stakeholders.

COMPETENCIES/SKILLS

  • Cloud Platform (AWS): Extensive hands-on experience architecting and operating data solutions on AWS; relevant AWS certifications (e.g., AWS Certified Data Analytics, AWS Solutions Architect) strongly preferred.
  • Data Warehousing: Deep expertise in data warehousing concepts, dimensional modeling, ETL/ELT processes, and enterprise data governance, with a focus on AWS-native and integrated solutions.
  • Programming Languages: Advanced proficiency in Python and Bash for automation, orchestration, and data processing tasks within AWS environments.
  • Data Integration: Proven ability to design and implement advanced data integration solutions supporting complex analytics and business intelligence requirements on AWS.
  • Database Management: Strong experience with both relational (e.g., Oracle, SQL Server, MySQL, Snowflake) and NoSQL (e.g., DynamoDB) databases, including AWS-native database services.
  • Data Quality & Security: Demonstrated commitment to maintaining high data quality, integrity, and security in AWS cloud and hybrid environments.
  • Tools & Technologies: Expertise with Snowflake, dbt, GitHub, Control-M, and familiarity with modern data engineering frameworks (e.g., Airflow, Fivetran, Matillion) as deployed on AWS.
  • Infrastructure: Solid understanding of both traditional on-premises (virtual/physical) and AWS cloud-based infrastructure, including Windows and Linux environments.
  • Open Source & AWS Services: Working knowledge of a variety of open-source tools and AWS services for data engineering, automation, and orchestration.
  • Leadership & Mentorship: Proven track record of leading design efforts, mentoring engineers, and fostering technical excellence within teams.
  • Problem-Solving: Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills, with meticulous attention to detail.
  • Collaboration: Outstanding communication, leadership, and cross-functional collaboration abilities, partnering effectively with business and technical stakeholders.
  • Continuous Improvement: Commitment to staying current with AWS advancements, industry trends, and driving innovation in data engineering practices.

title: Account Executive
description:
About Visure

Visure Solutions is a global leader in Requirements Application Lifecycle Management (ALM), empowering companies across safety-critical and business-critical industries. Our award-winning ALM platform supports the entire requirements lifecycle—from traceability and test management to risk and compliance. We proudly serve clients in Aerospace, Automotive, Medtech, Industrial Manufacturing, and other regulated sectors.

Location: Remote – LATAM

Type: Full-Time

Compensation: Base Salary based on experience, location + Commission

Modality: 100% Remote

About the Role

We’re looking for a motivated Account Executive to join our growing team. You’ll play a key role in driving new business and expanding existing customer relationships. This is a remote sales role focused on engaging inbound qualified leads, prospecting within your region, and working on upsell and cross-sell opportunities with our current clients.

You’ll manage the full sales cycle—from initial outreach to closing—and help shape how Visure engages with startups, mid-sized companies, and enterprise organizations navigating complex regulatory environments.

Core Responsabilities

  • Drive New Business: Prospect, qualify, and close new customers across your region.
  • Follow Up on Inbound Leads: Quickly engage with inbound prospects to book demos and identify qualified opportunities.
  • Grow Existing Accounts: Expand Visure’s presence within current accounts by identifying upsell and cross-sell opportunities.
  • Own the Sales Cycle: Strategically manage your pipeline from lead generation to close, using CRM tools to maintain accurate records.
  • Build Relationships: Develop and nurture strong relationships with technical and business stakeholders.
  • Collaborate Cross-Functionally: Work with marketing, customer success, and product teams to ensure customer satisfaction and optimize conversion.
  • Stay Organized: Update our CRM daily and engage with leads through a multichannel outreach approach (email, phone, LinkedIn, etc.).
  • Provide Market Feedback: Share insights from the field to help improve marketing campaigns and messaging.

Learning Objectives

If accepted, we will provide a paid onboarding training and resource for the first couple of weeks to get you up to speed.

  1. Learn the Requirements and Systems Engineering industry inside-out.
  2. Learn Visure’s toolsuite from the inside-out by watching demos in the video portal and attending other live demos.
  3. Learn our customer and industry pain points from the inside-out.
  4. Learning how to qualify leads to setup trials or demos and create opportunities for the Sales Team.

Skills and Experience Requirements

  1. Fluent in Spanish, Portuguese, and English (spoken and written) – Trilingual is a must
  2. 2–3 years of B2B sales experience , preferably in enterprise tech or SaaS
  3. Strong communication and presentation skills
  4. Ability to navigate complex sales cycles and organizations
  5. Experience using CRM platforms (Salesforce or similar)
  6. Tech-savvy with an eagerness to learn Visure’s product
  7. Self-driven, accountable, and effective in a remote and fast-paced environment
  8. Previous experience working remotely with stable internet access
  9. Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or a technical field is a plus

Why Joing Visure?

  1. Work with industry leaders and cutting-edge tech in a booming niche.
  2. Join a mission-driven team building solutions for real-world safety and compliance.
  3. Enjoy flexibility , a remote-first culture , and opportunities to grow into leadership or strategic sales roles.

Buscamos um(a) Especialista em Performance Web Front-End apaixonado(a) por otimizar a velocidade, a responsividade e a experiência do usuário das nossas aplicações web. O foco principal é garantir o carregamento ultrarrápido das páginas, melhorar as métricas de Core Web Vitals e aplicar as melhores práticas de SEO Técnico, resultando em melhor posicionamento nos mecanismos de busca e aumento nas taxas de conversão.

Principais Responsabilidades

1. Otimização de Performance:

- Analisar, diagnosticar e solucionar gargalos de performance no Front-End (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, imagens, fontes).

- Focar na melhoria contínua das métricas Core Web Vitals (LCP, FID/INP, CLS) e outras métricas de velocidade (TTFB, FCP, TTI).

- Implementar técnicas de otimização como code splitting, lazy loading, pré-carregamento de recursos (preloading/prefetching), compressão (Gzip/Brotli) e caching avançado.

2. SEO Técnico e Carregamento:

- Garantir a rastreabilidade (crawlability) e indexação eficiente das páginas por bots de mecanismos de busca.

- Otimizar a estrutura do DOM, o uso de HTML semântico e metatags.

- Trabalhar na renderização ideal (server-side, client-side ou híbrida/SSR) para equilibrar performance e SEO.

3. Monitoramento e Análise:

-Utilizar ferramentas como Google PageSpeed Insights, Lighthouse, WebPageTest, Google Search Console e ferramentas de RUM (Real User Monitoring) para monitorar e reportar a performance em ambientes de produção.

-Criar e manter dashboards de performance, identificando tendências e oportunidades de otimização.

4. Colaboração e Educação:

-Colaborar de perto com equipes de Design (UX/UI), Back-End e Marketing/SEO para garantir que as novas funcionalidades sejam lançadas com alta performance e aderência técnica.

• Domínio de Frameworks/Bibliotecas: Experiência avançada em pelo menos um dos principais frameworks de Front-End (React, Vue.js ou Angular), com foco na otimização de builds e carregamento.

• Otimização de Assets: Conhecimento profundo em otimização de imagens (WebP, AVIF, tag), font loading (FOIT, FOUT) e minificação de código.

• Ferramentas de Build/Bundling: Experiência com ferramentas como Webpack, Rollup ou Vite, configurando otimizações para produção.

• Infraestrutura/Rede: Entendimento de redes ( Content Delivery Networks (CDN) e estratégias de cache no navegador e no servidor.

• SEO Técnico: Conhecimento em Sitemap, Robots.txt, canonicalização, dados estruturados (Schema.org) e experiências de usuário mobile.

Habilidades Comportamentais (Soft Skills)

No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras.

As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose branqueada em Inocência (MS).

Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.

Quer fazer parte do nosso time? Então inscreva-se nesta oportunidade!

Esta vaga é exclusiva para Pessoas com Deficiência (PCD) com atuação na área de Gestão de Pessoas da unidade de Jaguariaíva .

Nosso objetivo é identificar e atrair profissionais cujos valores e competências estejam alinhados com a cultura da Arauco . Você será considerado para futuras oportunidades compatíveis com seu perfil.

Importante: Ao se cadastrar, anexe um único arquivo com seu currículo e laudo ou exame comprobatórios atualizados.

Principais atividades:

  • Realizar o lançamento e acompanhamento de notas fiscais para pagamento de fornecedores via SAP;
  • Realizar a abertura de requisições para compra de itens e reservas via almoxarifado;
  • Acompanhar a contratação e fazer cumprir os serviços de uso comum, tais como: portaria, restaurante, limpeza de áreas administrativas e de passagem, paisagismo, transfers, fretamento de veículos, área de lazer, conforme critérios e normas estabelecidas;
  • Acompanhar os serviços de manutenção predial administrativa, visando a conservação da infraestrutura física das instalações e a qualidade dos serviços de apoio administrativo;
  • Monitorar os serviços de copa, recepção de correios, malotes, correspondências, insumos, entre outros.

Requisitos:

  • Ensino Médio Completo;
  • Cursando Ensino Superior (Desejável);
  • Conhecimento em SAP;
  • Conhecimento do Pacote Office;
  • Possuir laudo médico ou exames comprobatórios atualizados;
  • Disponibilidade para residir em Jaguariaíva ou Arapoti.

title: Sr. Program Manager Office
description:

We’re privately held, profitable, and have been on a solid growth trajectory since day one. We care deeply about our clients, our partners, and our people. We prefer the word ‘partner’ over ‘vendor’, and our investment in professional relationships is a reflection of that philosophy. We pride ourselves on our technical acumen, our collaborative problem-solving ability, and the warm professionalism of our teams.

We are seeking a Program Manager on a contract basis. In this role, you will lead complex cross-functional programs that advance the PMO’s FY26 strategy for operational excellence. You will strengthen program management processes, introduce governance standards, and drive adoption of best practices across multiple teams.

Your impact will be measurable—helping streamline operations, reduce costs, improve efficiency, and enable smarter decision-making. The initial contract length is three months with a strong possibility of extension based on performance.

In this role, you will be expected to lead complex cross-functional programs that drive a range of capabilities, including supporting strategic planning, portfolio management and governance, and ad hoc initiatives for leadership. You will also play a key role in maturing program management processes, tools, and systems across teams.

Key to this role is the ability to gather and document business requirements for internal tools and systems and translate them into Technical Design Documents for submission to software development teams. You will also assist the tools and systems lead in the BPR PMO prioritize the product backlog of feature requests across multiple tools and systems. Central to your success will be the development and execution of a strong change management and communications strategy that enables smooth transitions and lasting impact.

Responsibilities:

  • Act as a business analyst to gather requirements across different functional teams, translate them into design documents and user journeys for submission to software development teams.

  • Create testing plans as well as tracking systems to ensure timely completion of testing.

  • Build business cases for prioritized projects and create leadership presentations to secure advocacy and resourcing.
  • Assess tools and systems used across functions; recommend consolidation and implement governance standards.

  • Lead complex, cross-functional projects while demonstrating excellence in program and portfolio management.
  • Develop standardized templates, frameworks, and operating structures; drive adoption across teams.
  • Know where to drive standardization and where to allow for flexibility and creativity.
  • Deploy strong change management and communication strategies to ensure smooth transitions.
  • Facilitate meetings including driving the agenda and driving to closure on key decisions.
  • Take over PMO related tasks to run day-to-day operations and reporting.

  • Solid experience managing and leading complex, cross-functional projects.

Nice to Have Skills:

O que buscamos num profissional?

Neste cenário de crescimento sustentável, buscamos talentos para enfrentar os desafios do setor, que tenham atitude, sejam engajados e saibam estabelecer parcerias na busca pela excelência.

A Tereos acredita que todos os profissionais podem contribuir com o crescimento do grupo. Por isso, pessoas com deficiência são bem-vindas a nossa empresa.

Sobre a Tereos

Com visão de longo prazo no processamento de matérias-primas agrícolas e desenvolvimento de produtos alimentícios de qualidade, a Tereos é uma das líderes nos mercados de açúcar, álcool/etanol e amidos. Os compromissos do Grupo com a sociedade e com o meio ambiente têm contribuído com a performance da companhia no longo prazo, enquanto reforça nossa atuação responsável. O Grupo cooperativo Tereos reúne 12.000 agricultores e possui expertise reconhecida no processamento de beterraba, cana-de-açúcar, cereais e batata. Com operação em 15 países, 43 unidades industriais e o compromisso de 15.800 colaboradores, a Tereos atende seus clientes em seus mercados locais, com uma oferta ampla de produtos. Em 2022/23, o Grupo obteve um faturamento de € 6,6 bilhões.

Tereos no Brasil

A Tereos no Brasil é composta pela Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil, Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil e Tereos Commodities Brasil. No noroeste do Estado de São Paulo, a Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil concentra suas sete unidades de processamento e duas refinarias. A Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil, com operação em Palmital (SP), diversifica o portfólio da Tereos Brasil com a fabricação de produtos derivados de milho. A Tereos Commodities opera como trading e possui escritórios em diversos países.

Identificar novas oportunidades de melhoria, atuar diretamente com as áreas de operações e demais, a fim de melhorarmos de forma contínua a qualidade no atendimento e consequentemente a satisfação dos clientes. Temos como visão aprimorarmos a nossa excelência operacional.

Principais responsabilidades

  • Hunting com ABS/ABM: mapear contas-alvo, identificar buying centers (C-level, Data Leaders, TI, Operações) e conduzir abordagens multithread.
  • Prospecção executiva: construir relacionamento consultivo, qualificar dores (valor, risco, eficiência), definir hipóteses de valor e próximos passos.

  • Parcerias: trabalhar com parceiros tecnológicos na conquista de novos negócios.
  • Representar a Apgar em eventos do ecossistema de dados/IA .

Perfil que buscamos

  • Hunter com histórico consistente de abertura de novos logos enterprise em serviços consultoria de dados/IA, governança, MDM ou plataformas de dados.
  • Linguagem de negócio + fluência técnica : fala com CDO/CIO/COO e também debate em bom nível com equipes de dados e governança (sem precisar ser “mão no código”).
  • ABS/ABM practitioner : sabe montar account plans , mapear poder/influência, criar value hypotheses e navegar ciclos complexos.
  • Experiente na Orquestração de propostas ponta a ponta, com ownership da narrativa de valor e da negociação .
  • Networking ativo no ecossistema corporativo de Dados, TI e AI no Brasil/LatAm capaz de gerar pipeline.

Diferenciais que contam pontos

  • Experiência com ApgarIA ou ofertas de AI para Operações (manufatura/supply chain, agentes de IA, otimização).

Como medimos sucesso (primeiros 6–12 meses)

  • Novos logos qualificados e fechados (mid-large/enterprise).

  • MVPs/PoVs vendidos com tese de valor clara (Pathfinder → MVP → roll-out).

Apgar Group é um empregador de igualdade de oportunidades e valoriza a diversidade em nossa empresa. Não discriminamos com base em raça, religião, cor, nacionalidade, gênero, orientação sexual, idade, estado civil ou deficiência.

Oferecemos a possibilidade de te incorporares numa empresa que proporciona tudo o que é necessário para o máximo desenvolvimento profissional:

title: Public Relations Manager - LATAM
description:
About Cooler Master

Cooler Master is a global computer hardware manufacturer founded in 1992 in Taiwan. The company is known for its award-winning PC components, including cases, power supplies, cooling solutions, and accessories.

In addition to retail product lines, Cooler Master also serves as an OEM partner to major technology brands worldwide. The company has grown steadily through a strong focus on innovation, design, and user-driven product development. Headquartered in Taipei, Cooler Master operates manufacturing facilities in China and maintains regional offices across the globe.

Role Overview

Lead public relations for Latin America (LATAM) to elevate Cooler Master’s visibility across key markets such as Brazil, Mexico, Argentina, and Chile.

You’ll manage PR execution for launches and ongoing brand activations—aligning local media, translating technical information into engaging stories, and ensuring consistent communication with global and regional marketing teams.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the LATAM PR Plan – Develop and execute the regional PR calendar and embargo plan; ensure alignment with global launches and LATAM sales priorities.
  • Build Media Relationships – Cultivate strong connections with top-tier tech and gaming editors, reviewers, and influencers across Portuguese and Spanish-speaking markets.
  • Host Press Briefings & Events – Lead virtual and local events; manage press lists, invitations, materials, and post-event follow-ups.
  • Coordinate Product Reviews – Manage the sample allocation, delivery, and follow-up process with regional media outlets.
  • Partner Collaboration – Drive joint PR opportunities with distributors, e-commerce partners, and brand collaborators.
  • Content Localization – Adapt global press materials for LATAM audiences to ensure cultural and linguistic accuracy.
  • Monitor & Report – Track press coverage, analyze media performance metrics, and deliver post-launch summaries.
  • Maintain Compliance – Ensure consistent application of embargoes, NDA terms, and authorized content usage.

Qualifications

  • Education : Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Communications, Journalism, Marketing, or related field.
  • Experience : 5–8+ years in tech, consumer electronics, or gaming PR across LATAM. Proven track record in media relations and launch management.
  • Regional Expertise :
  • Strong understanding of LATAM media ecosystem and regional communication styles.
  • Existing relationships with major tech and gaming outlets.
  • Language Skills :
  • Fluent in English and either Portuguese or Spanish (bilingual proficiency preferred).
  • Execution & Measurement :
  • Strong organizational skills, ability to manage multiple launches.
  • Familiarity with PR metrics such as share of voice and media reach.

Who You Are

  • A proactive communicator with high accountability and attention to detail.
  • Skilled at relationship-building across diverse markets and cultures.
  • Confident managing embargoes, timelines, and media expectations.
  • Adaptable and independent, yet collaborative with global teammates.

description:

Junte-se à Nossa Equipe de Saúde Digital!

A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicas e Médicos Especialistas em Endocrinologia! * SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH: *

A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas.

* O QUE PROCURAMOS: *

Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na modalidade de consultas de especialidade em Endocrinologia , de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos;

DESCRIÇÃO DAS ATIVIDADES:

  • Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em Endocrinologia de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação.
  • Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios Endocrinológicos .
  • Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de conduzir anamnese virtual para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de risco e gravidade em Endocrinologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.
  • Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.
  • Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente.
  • Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças Endocrinológicas .
  • Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.
  • Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.
  • Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas.
  • Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca dos principais problemas de saúde em Endocrinologia.
  • Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.
  • Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.
  • Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.
  • Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais.
  • Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo.
  • Manter-se bem-informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes.
  • Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.

REQUISITOS

Formação Acadêmica:

  • Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA
  • Obrigatório: RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO EM ENDOCRINOLOGIA

Certificações:

  • Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM);
  • Certificado de Título de Especialista - RQE (emitido pelo Conselho respectivo) em Endocrinologia ;
  • Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil).

Experiência:

Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em Endocrinologia , sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina e Atenção Primária à Saúde;

Conhecimentos Específicos para a função:

Prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios Endócrinos e metabólicos..

Competências Comportamentais:

Comprometimento com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional.

Outros Requisitos Importantes:

Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável.

REMOTO

MODELO DE CONTRATAÇÃO: Contratação em regime de Prestador de Serviços por contrato Pessoa Jurídica, necessário fazer parte como representante legal ou sócio de um CNPJ ativo.

title: Sênior Gen AI Engineer - Inglês avançado/fluente
description:
Contratação PJ - valor em reais

Atuação remota

Cliente internacional - pode haver necessidade de atuar em outro fuso horário

  • Projetar e desenvolver soluções baseadas em GenAI e LLMs com ferramentas como Langchain e pipelines RAG.

  • Domínio em Python , Langchain e SQL .
  • Conhecimento profundo sobre LLMs: tuning de prompts, embeddings, bancos vetoriais e fluxos com agentes.
  • Background sólido em engenharia de software ou machine learning com visão sistêmica.
  • Experiência com AWS , Azure ou GCP .
  • Perfil colaborativo, com autonomia e excelente comunicação.
  • Inglês avançado/fluente para conversação

Diferenciais:

  • Mínimo de 1 ano de experiência prática com LLMs e GenAI.
  • Vivência em pipelines de produtos de IA ou deploys fim a fim.
  • Familiaridade com práticas de MLOps e padrões escaláveis de deploy.
  • Experiência em projetos com clientes ou times multifuncionais de IA.

title: Contratação de Social Media com Habilidades de Design e Redação
description:
O objetivo é encontrar um profissional de social media que possua habilidades tanto em design quanto em redação. O trabalho envolve a criação de conteúdos visuais e textuais para redes sociais, exigindo criatividade, domínio de ferramentas de design gráfico e excelente comunicação escrita. O público-alvo são seguidores e potenciais clientes nas redes sociais. Espera-se que o profissional entregue posts atraentes, alinhados à estratégia da marca, e que compreenda tendências digitais para aumentar o engajamento.

Responsabilidades

Planejar e executar estratégias de conteúdo para redes sociais, alinhadas aos objetivos da marca e às tendências do mercado digital.

Criar posts, stories, vídeos curtos e anúncios, desenvolvendo tanto o conceito visual quanto o texto criativo de forma integrada.

Gerenciar o calendário editorial, garantindo consistência de comunicação e coerência entre campanhas, datas e temas relevantes.

Produzir artes e peças visuais utilizando ferramentas de design gráfico (como Canva, Photoshop, Illustrator ou similares), sempre seguindo o guia de identidade visual da marca.

Escrever legendas, roteiros e chamadas atrativas, com domínio da escrita criativa e foco em engajamento e conversão.

Monitorar métricas e interações, analisando resultados de campanhas e propondo melhorias contínuas com base em dados.

Interagir com a comunidade online, respondendo mensagens e comentários de forma empática, clara e dentro da voz da marca.

Colaborar com outras áreas (como marketing, performance, design e atendimento) para garantir integração e consistência nas entregas.

Manter-se atualizado(a) sobre tendências de redes sociais, comportamento do público e novas ferramentas de criação e análise.

Qualificações

Experiência prévia em gestão de redes sociais e criação de conteúdo (portfólio será considerado um diferencial).

Domínio de ferramentas de design gráfico, como Photoshop ou Figma.

Excelente escrita e criatividade, com capacidade de adaptar o tom de voz a diferentes plataformas e públicos.

Noções de fotografia, vídeo e edição básica, para criação de conteúdos ágeis e originais.

Conhecimento das principais métricas de engajamento, alcance e conversão em plataformas como Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn e Facebook.

Capacidade de organização e autogestão, com atenção a prazos e detalhes.

Perfil colaborativo, proatividade e interesse genuíno em criar conteúdo relevante e de impacto.

title: STEM SME (Portuguese) - 47319
description:
About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. We are looking for accomplished Tutors and Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) to contribute their expertise in Social Sciences, Humanities, and STEM disciplines . Your input will directly help improve AI models by ensuring they can handle complex, graduate-level questions across disciplines.

  • Create structured, graduate-level tasks, prompts, and problem sets in your area of expertise.

  • Maintain clear, organized records of tasks, solutions, and evaluations.

  • Advanced degree (Master’s, PhD, or Postdoctoral experience) in your field of expertise.
  • Strong subject knowledge in one or more disciplines within Social Sciences, Humanities, or STEM.
  • Excellent academic writing and analytical skills.
  • Ability to design structured, verifiable assessment questions.

Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation based on experience and expertise.
  • Flexible working hours and remote work environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.

title: Electrical Supervisor
description:
Offshore Electrical Supervisor - Drillship in Brazil - Local payroll

* Offshore Experience working on a drillship or Semi is essential *

Overview

We are seeking an experienced and proactive Electrical Supervisor to oversee all electrical systems and operations onboard a drillship.

In this role, you will ensure high operational efficiency, compliance with safety standards, and support smooth offshore drilling activities. This role is critical to ensuring the continued success of our offshore operations while fostering an inclusive, safety-first work environment.

This position offers an exciting opportunity to work in a dynamic and diverse offshore environment. Candidates with leadership capabilities, technical expertise, and experience in drilling operations are encouraged to apply.

Responsibilities

  • Supervise the installation, maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair of onboard electrical systems, including complex drilling and offshore equipment.
  • Ensure compliance with all safety regulations, electrical codes, and offshore operation standards.
  • Coordinate with the drilling and mechanical teams to ensure seamless integration of electrical systems in daily operations.
  • Develop, review, and update maintenance schedules for electrical equipment and systems.
  • Conduct routine inspections and testing of all electrical systems to identify and address potential hazards or failures.
  • Provide leadership, guidance, and training to a diverse team of electricians and support crew members.
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to resolve technical challenges and implement long-term solutions for system efficiency.
  • Maintain accurate records of electrical works, inspections, breakdowns, and necessary upgrades for equipment.
  • Contribute to the safety culture on the drillship by adhering to and promoting a safe work environment, including performing safety audits and toolbox talks.
  • Work within teams to prepare for emergencies and respond promptly to electrical system failures or incidents.

Experience :

  • Minimum of 2 years of experience in a supervisor role, preferably on a drillship or semi-submersible
  • Strong understanding of marine electrical systems, offshore drilling equipment, and high-voltage systems.
  • Technical Skills : Proficiency in troubleshooting electrical systems, managing control panels, and handling PLC systems.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of international offshore standards, electrical codes, and safety regulations.
  • Proven ability to lead and work with diverse teams in high-pressure and dynamic environments.
  • Physical fitness to work in an offshore setting, with appropriate certifications (e.g., BOSIET, HUET, or OGUK Medical Certificate).
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills to ensure effective collaboration across teams.

Day-to-day

  • Inspect, maintain, and repair electrical systems to ensure uninterrupted operations.
  • Oversee electrical team members, assigning tasks and providing technical guidance as needed.
  • Communicate with the drilling and operations team to address any immediate power or system issues affecting performance.
  • Monitor and report electrical maintenance progress to onboard management and onshore support teams.
  • Document all findings during inspections and repairs, updating maintenance logs accordingly.
  • Provide mentorship to less-experienced team members, fostering an inclusive and supportive learning environment.

description:

Overview of the role:

We are looking for a Business Intelligence Analyst to join our team. This professional will be responsible for taking raw information – numbers or qualitative data sets – and constructing narratives that help our business colleagues to make better decisions. The primary goal of this position is to take large volumes of complex data, extract insights, and help solve problems.

- Work with stakeholders to understand reporting needs, identifying and querying data sources to get the required data.

- Deploy data, reports, and dashboards to Tableau; develop reports according to analyst-defined specifications

- Conduct technical training.

- Maintain and document the operational environment.

- Maintain and process SQL Server SPs and queries.

Requirements:

- At least 3 years of experience developing Business Intelligence dashboards and reports, analyzing, and visualizing data.

- An understanding of Tableau administration, licensing, security, and deployment, and at least 1 year of previous work experience using Tableau.

- A solid understanding of the concepts involved in modeling relational data.

- Strong analytic skills, with a hands-on approach with the ability to deliver commitments.

- Superior organizational skills, with a disciplined approach to implementation, support, and documentation.

- Experience with ETL of data from a variety of sources using SSIS, Python, or similar technologies (is a plus).

- Knowledge of SQL Server database architecture (components and processes of the database) and/or experience with creating tabular data models in SQL Server (is a plus).

- Advanced English level.

Benefits:

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

description:
É apaixonado(a) por tecnologia, orientado(a) a resultados e gosta de desafios?

Então venha fazer parte do time de UPXers e nos ajude em nossa missão: transformar a internet em um ambiente mais seguro para empresas e pessoas!

Com forte comprometimento, inovação e de forma dinâmica você será responsável por:

  • Auxiliar na configuração, manutenção e monitoramento de redes de computadores.
  • Prestar suporte técnico aos serviços oferecidos pela UPX ao cliente final.
  • Monitorar incidentes de redes, e ataques DDoS.
  • Auxiliar na configuração e gerenciamento de equipamentos de rede (roteadores, switches, firewalls, etc.).
  • Colaborar com a equipe de TI em projetos de infraestrutura e segurança.
  • Executar e documentar processos, procedimentos e incidentes relacionados à rede e à segurança de TI.
  • Participar de treinamentos e atualizações sobre novas tecnologias e práticas de segurança.

Desejável:

  • Cursando ou formado em Redes de Computadores, Ciência da Computação, Engenharia da Computação, Sistemas de Informação, Segurança da Informação ou áreas correlatas.
  • Conhecimento em protocolos de rede (IPv4, IPv6, TCP/UDP e DNS).
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de monitoramento e segurança de redes.
  • Experiência prévia na instalação e configuração de equipamentos de rede, como roteadores, switches, firewalls e sistemas de detecção e prevenção de intrusão (IDS/IPS).
  • Habilidade para resolver problemas técnicos de forma ágil e eficiente.
  • Boa comunicação e capacidade de trabalhar em equipe.
  • Diferencial: Certificações como CCNA, JNCIA-Junos, JNCIA-DC, MTCNA ou equivalentes.
  • Experiência com protocolo BGP é altamente desejável.

Buscamos por uma pessoa para o time da UPX que possua:

  • Disponibilidade de horário para atuar em escalas de revezamento, sem ser jornada Comercial.

Sobre a UPX:

A UPX está há duas décadas no mercado, é referência em mitigação de ataques DDoS, e destaque no monitoramento, identificação, tratamento, prevenção de incidentes e entrega de conteúdo (CDN e Streaming) com elevado desempenho. Está presente em Campinas (SP) e Miami (EUA), tem em seu portfólio grandes clientes do setor bancário e financeiro, operadoras de telecom e provedores de internet (ISP).

Atua combatendo ataques, vulnerabilidades e ameaças cibernéticas com apoio de um time técnico de Segurança da Informação e Engenharia de Redes que operam por meio de SOC (Security Operations Center), NOC (Network Operations Center) e Scrubbing Centers (Centros de Mitigação).
