title: Country Operations Manager
description:
Country Operations Manager – LATAM

Location: Brazil/ Remote

Job Type: Full-time contract

About Trantor Inc

Trantor Inc. is a global technology services and consulting company headquartered in Palo Alto, California, with delivery centers across the USA, Canada, and India. We partner with Fortune 500 companies and high-growth enterprises to drive digital transformation through Product Engineering, Cloud Enablement, Data & AI Solutions, Automation, and Customer Success Services. At Trantor, we thrive in a collaborative, agile, and people-first environment.

Why Join Trantor?

Trantor offers the opportunity to work on diverse, cutting-edge projects in a culture that values innovation, continuous learning, and collaboration. Enjoy the flexibility of a remote role while contributing to impactful initiatives in a truly global organization.

About the Opportunity

We are seeking an experienced and results-driven Country Manager – LATAM to lead and scale our operations across the region. This role is 80% operations-focused, with responsibility for resource management, workforce planning, employee engagement, HR, HR compliance, and strategic growth. The remaining 20% requires technical acumen to manage tech people, understand how tech operations are run, and participate in technical discussions with clients.

The right candidate will have proven experience in managing, scaling, and setting up IT/Tech teams, ensuring smooth delivery and operational excellence. They must be adept at building and inspiring high-performing teams, driving compliance and retention, and cultivating trusted long-term relationships with clients and stakeholders.

What’s Exciting About This Role?

  • Lead and shape our entire LATAM operation, with the autonomy to make high-impact decisions.
  • Build and inspire a high-performing, multicultural team while forging strong client relationships.
  • Play a pivotal role in driving operational excellence and market presence.
  • Work in a fast-paced, global environment where your ideas are implemented, not just discussed.

Key Responsibilities

, HR & Resource Management

  • Oversee all LATAM resources to ensure productivity and quality.
  • Manage the full employee lifecycle including hiring, onboarding, HR compliance, and performance management.
  • Monitor attrition rates and implement proactive retention strategies.
  • Drive employee satisfaction through engagement programs, career development, and structured feedback channels.

Tech Operations Oversight

  • Manage and scale tech operations and delivery teams .
  • Ensure alignment between business objectives and technical delivery.
  • Provide credible oversight in technical discussions with clients.
  • Stakeholder & Customer Engagement
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders and customers across LATAM.
  • Act as the primary liaison for client needs, service delivery, and customer success.
  • Represent the company at local and regional events, forums, and client meetings.

Operational Leadership & Strategic Growth

  • Lead daily operations, ensuring efficiency, compliance, and alignment with corporate policies.
  • Collaborate with HR, Finance, and global teams for seamless cross-functional workflows.
  • Monitor performance metrics and provide regular updates to regional/global leadership.
  • Adapt and execute market-specific strategies aligned with global objectives.

Financial & Market Insight Contribution

  • Support budget planning, resource allocation, and cost optimization.
  • Provide local market intelligence to inform global strategic decisions.

Key Qualifications & Skills

  • Experience: 8–12 years in senior leadership or country management, preferably in the IT/Consulting sector.
  • People & HR Management: Proven success in leading teams, driving workforce planning, employee engagement, HR processes, and HR compliance , with measurable improvement in retention.
  • Tech Operations Oversight: Demonstrated ability to set up, scale, and manage IT/Tech teams (Must Have)
  • Stakeholder Engagement: Strong track record in building trusted relationships with clients, partners, and internal stakeholders.
  • Strategic & Operational Skills: Ability to translate business objectives into actionable operational and delivery plans, while ensuring compliance and efficiency.
  • Communication: Fluency in English (written and spoken) is required; Spanish and Portuguese proficiency are strong advantages.
  • Technical Tools: Familiarity with CRM systems, business management platforms, and performance reporting tools.

Why Join Us?

  • Strategic leadership role with direct impact on our LATAM operations
  • Competitive remuneration (salary only)
  • Work within a global and fast-growing organization
  • Friendly, supportive, positive, and professional team of experts
  • Multicultural and diverse environment
  • Full-time employment
  • Remote work conditions

title: Regional Sales Manager
description:
Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks® everything starts and ends with our mission:

Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life. Our vision is a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we’re looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.

Who We Are

This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters. Job Description

Your Career

The Regional Sales Manager is a significant driver of company revenue and growth. As an experienced and dynamic sales professional, you’re responsible for leading and driving sales engagements. You’re motivated by the desire to solve critical challenges facing our customer’s secure environment, so you’re prepared to connect them with a solution for every stage of threat prevention.

You’ll be responsible for meeting and exceeding your quota by crafting and implementing strategic territory plans targeting deployments of the Palo Alto Networks Next Generation Security Platform. This is a unique opportunity for a closer with a go-getter mentality to win business and market share by actively displacing competing technologies.

Palo Alto Networks is leading the charge in platformization, offering best-in-breed solutions that enable customers to build a truly zero-trust security architecture and navigate critical transformations. To ensure our sales team is equipped to guide customers, we've developed FLIGHT, an immersive onboarding program. Flight blends virtual and in-person learning at our headquarters, where new sales hires will participate in dynamic cohorts, fully dedicated to their training without customer distractions. This focused approach ensures they emerge as well-prepared sales professionals, ready to help customers leverage our comprehensive portfolio.

Your Impact

  • As a Regional Sales Manager(Federal DoD and/or Civilian), you will drive and orchestrate complex sales cycles and work with our internal partners and teams to best serve the customer

  • Bring your experience and consultative selling skills to initiate long-standing relationships with prospective customers and executive sponsors

  • Your focus will be to create and implement strategic account plans focused on attaining enterprise-wide deployments

  • Understanding of the strategic competitive landscape and customer needs so you can effectively position Palo Alto Networks

  • Engage a programmatic approach to demand to generate, develop, and expand your territory

  • Leverage prospect stories to create a compelling value proposition with insights into value for that specific account.

  • Stay updated on industry news and trends, and how they affect Palo Alto Networks products and services

  • Travel as necessary within your territory, and to company-wide meeting

Qualifications

Your Experience

  • Experience and knowledge of SaaS-based architectures, ideally in a networking and/or security context

  • Experience cultivating mutually beneficial relationships with our channel partners to bring channel-centric go-to-market approach for our customers

  • Have and able to lead all aspects of the sales cycle with the ability to uncover, qualifying, developing, and closing new, white-space territories and accounts

  • Deep knowledge of the (U.S. DOD and/or intelligence community/or Civilian Agencies)

  • Possess a successful track record selling complex-solutions

  • Excellent time management skills, and work with high levels of autonomy and self-direction

  • Highly competitive, ramp quickly, extremely adaptive, and pride yourself on exceeding production goals

Additional Information

The Team

Palo Alto Networks has brought technology to market that is reshaping the cybersecurity threat and protection landscape. Our ability to protect digital transactions is limited only by our ability to establish relationships with our potential customers and help them understand how our products can protect their environments. This is where our sales teams come in. Our sales team members work together with large organizations to keep their digital information safe. Our passionate sales teams educate, inspire, and empower our potential clients.

As part of our sales team, you are empowered with unmatched systems and tools, constantly updated research and sales libraries, and a team built on joint success. You won’t find someone at Palo Alto Networks that isn’t committed to your success – with everyone pitching in to assist when it comes to solutions selling, learning, and development. As a member of our sales team, you are motivated by a solutions-focused sales environment and find fulfillment in working with clients to resolve incredibly complex cyberthreats. You’re an amazing sales person – you’re just looking for something more substantial and challenging as your next step.

Our Commitment

We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

Palo Alto Networks is evolving and changing the nature of work to meet the needs of our employees now and in the future through FLEXWORK, our approach to how we work. From benefits to learning, location to leadership, we’ve rethought and recreated every aspect of the employee experience at Palo Alto Networks. And because it FLEXes around each individual employee based on their individual choices, employees are empowered to push boundaries and help us all evolve, together.

Responsabilidades
  • Ownership de módulos front (CMS e apps adjacentes): arquitetura → entrega → observabilidade, conduzindo design reviews/ADRs , code reviews e mentoria do time.
  • Evoluir o front com React + Next.js (App Router/RSC) usando SSR/ISR/SSG e on-demand revalidation (webhooks/filas/CDN/edge).
  • Definir modelos de conteúdo e migrações de schema (versionadas, com rollback) para múltiplos sites/idiomas.
  • Implementar workflows editoriais (draft → review → approved → published), agendamento , preview seguro (tokens HMAC/JWT de uso único, TTL curto) e rollback .
  • Projetar RBAC/ABAC (policies/claims por tipo/campo/tenant) com auditoria (quem mudou o quê e quando).
  • Orquestrar publicação e invalidação (escopos por página/coleção/tenant), cache SWR, estratégias em CDN/edge .
  • Liderar Design System/Storybook , tokens de design e theming multi-marca ; garantir WCAG AA e LGPD/GDPR .
  • Implantar experimentos ( feature flags , A/B testing ) e analytics por evento/usuário com consentimento.
  • Estabelecer CI/CD com gates de qualidade (lint, typecheck, unit/integração/E2E/contrato) e runbooks/incident response .
Requisitos (must-have)
  • 5+ anos com React e 2+ com Next.js (App Router) e TypeScript .
  • Proficiência em SSR/ISR/SSG , on-demand revalidation , webhooks , filas (ex.: Redis/SQS/Cloud Tasks) e CDN/edge (invalidação segmentada).
  • Validação compartilhada (ex.: RHF + Zod) e autorização server-side ; experiência prática com RBAC/ABAC , multitenancy e i18n .
  • CSP e security headers , OAuth/OIDC , cookies , rate limiting e boas práticas antiabuso no front.
  • Testes : unitários (Jest/Vitest, RTL), E2E (Cypress/Playwright) e contrato (ex.: Pact); CI/CD com ambientes de preview.
  • Observabilidade (Sentry/OpenTelemetry), logs estruturados e métricas de produção (Core Web Vitals, p95 TTFB).
KPIs do papel
  • p95 TTFB (páginas cacheadas), tempo de invalidação (webhook → página atualizada).
  • Lead time de publicação, taxa de rollback , erros por 1k req .
  • Cobertura de testes por módulo e saúde de Core Web Vitals (RUM).
Diferenciais (nice-to-have)
  • Experiência com CMS headless (Sanity/Contentful/Strapi/Keystone) ou home-grown CMS .
  • Busca (Algolia/OpenSearch/Elastic), feature flags (LaunchDarkly/GrowthBook), Design System em escala.
  • Noções de Node/Nest/Prisma ou Go para colaborar em APIs leves e contratos.
Cultura & Soft Skills
  • Nosso CTO possui uma trajetória sólida e internacional em engenharia de dados, inteligência artificial e arquitetura de software corporativo , com mais de 10 anos de experiência em bancos globais e empresas de tecnologia de ponta . Atuou liderando times multidisciplinares e projetos estratégicos em IA, Data Science Engineering, Cloud e Go , entregando soluções escaláveis e seguras em ambientes altamente regulados e críticos.
  • Proatividade, comunicação clara e mente de produto (trade-offs, priorização).
  • Prática com mentoria , feedbacks e colaboração com UX, Back-End e Plataforma/DevOps .
  • Mentalidade de melhoria contínua , foco em acessibilidade e experiência editorial.
  • Trabalhe com um time enxuto, técnico e colaborativo , em um ambiente que valoriza inovação, qualidade e velocidade .
  • Tenha autonomia real para propor soluções e influenciar decisões arquiteturais.

title: Técnico mecânico
description:
A NEUMAN & ESSER impulsiona a transição energética e a economia circular com confiabilidade e soluções integradas para a infraestrutura de energia do futuro. Nossas soluções em compressão, com tecnologia própria de vedação, são usadas no processamento industrial de gases, tanto na indústria tradicional de petróleo e gás, como na economia do hidrogênio verde. O portfólio de produtos também inclui sistemas de produção de hidrogênio sustentável, como eletrolisadores e reformadores, as principais tecnologias para a demanda futura por energia limpa.

Com mais de um século de experiência na compressão de hidrogênio, a NEUMAN & ESSER é hoje a especialista em toda a cadeia de valor de H2. Quando se trata de dar vida a projetos ambiciosos, a NEUMAN & ESSER é o seu parceiro - desde a avaliação de potenciais plantas, viabilidade e financiamento do projeto, passando pela engenharia, construção e comissionamento, até à comercialização dos gases produzidos. Nossas soluções em engenharia de processos mecânicos apresentam diferenciais expressivos para a moagem e classificação de matérias-primas e materiais reciclados. Os nossos sistemas demonstram uma contribuição essencial em aplicações como tinta em pó e enriquecimento protéico, bem como na produção de materiais de alta performance para sistemas de armazenamento de energia em baterias.

A confiabilidade e a disponibilidade são a base de parcerias de longo prazo e são garantidas em nossas plantas com um serviço digital 360° durante a operação. A continuidade de uma empresa familiar com quase 200 anos e a nossa rede global de fabricação, vendas e serviços, garantem a proximidade junto aos nossos clientes. Seja em projetos envolvendo máquinas novas, seja na área de serviços, peças OEM ou qualquer atividade de pós-vendas, estamos perto do nosso cliente. Orientados a soluções ágeis, criativas e inovadoras, desenvolvemos o conhecimento dos nossos mais de 1.700 colaboradores para atender as necessidades do mercado.

Se você busca se desenvolver profissionalmente, com habilidades inovadoras venha fazer parte da NEUMAN & ESSER .

title: Water & Sanitation Expert
description:
Join Mútua as a Short-Term Expert Reviewer for the Water & Sanitation System Transition in Latin America

Are you a researcher, consultant, or practitioner with deep expertise in the sustainability transitions of Water & Sanitation systems in Latin America?

Mútua is bringing together a select group of qualified experts for a short-term, paid engagement to collectively review the content of our intelligence platform—created to support funders seeking to accelerate the transition toward a more regenerative, equitable, and resilient water & sanitation system in the region.

About the Role

This is a temporary expert engagement, compensated on an hourly basis (with rates to be agreed upon individually). As a contributor, you will help refine and validate the knowledge embedded in our platform, ensuring it accurately reflects strategic priorities, transition pathways, and systemic leverage points relevant to water & sanitation in Latin America.

We are looking for individuals with a systems-informed perspective on:

  • Key transition pathways for equitable and sustainable water & sanitation access
  • Interventions linking water security, public health, livelihoods and climate resilience
  • The role of policy, finance, innovation, and grassroots action in driving transformation

Whether your experience is in integrated water resource management, rural and urban sanitation, water justice, climate-resilient infrastructure, or water governance—your insights will help funders better identify and support transformative initiatives.

About Mútua

Mútua is an AI-powered intelligence platform that connects mission-driven funders—from philanthropic foundations to impact investors—with innovators such as startups, NGOs, and research institutions. We align capital with systemic solutions in critical systems like food, healthcare, and energy.

By transforming fragmented impact data into actionable intelligence, we empower funders to make faster, more strategic, and more impactful decisions.

Who We’re Looking For

We invite applications from Water & Sanitation experts with:

  • Proven knowledge and experience in water & sanitation systems in Latin America
  • A strong grasp of systemic and cross-sectoral dynamics
  • The ability to provide strategic and constructive feedback on frameworks, content, and priorities

Fluency in English is required, as all content to be reviewed is written in English.

This is a remote, flexible opportunity. We welcome applicants based across the Americas and Europe.

If you're committed to shaping the future of food, agriculture, and land in Latin America—and want to contribute to a tool that mobilizes capital for systemic change—we’d love to hear from you.

Keeta, the international subsidiary of Meituan—the global delivery giant—is on a mission to revolutionize food and consumer product delivery worldwide. With our core belief: "We help people eat better, live better," we're taking innovation to the global stage! Within just one year, Keeta has become an industry leader in Hong Kong. What We Need From You

  • Have excellent business negotiation and market development capabilities, be loyal to business goals, have insight into the needs of users, and be brave to embrace challenges.
  • Have basic data analysis skills and master office software applications. Experience in working with charts/graphs is required.
  • Integrity, honesty and resilience. Passionate about work and possessing a strong team spirit.
  • English and Portuguese can be used as working languages.

Why Join Keeta

Keeta is redefining the future of food delivery with a clear vision and innovative spirit. As a fast-scaling brand under Meituan's global ambition, we offer a unique blend of stability and startup energy, providing boundless opportunities for personal and professional growth. Whether you want to specialize in your field or gain cross-functional experience, Keeta empowers you to take charge of your career.

As we expand globally, we are committed to building a workplace that reflects our unique culture while incorporating global best practices. You'll be part of a company that's transforming the delivery industry while supporting local communities, empowering merchants, and delivering outstanding customer experiences.

At Keeta, you'll collaborate with a passionate and pragmatic global team across over 94 countries, bringing diverse perspectives that drive creativity and innovation. We believe diversity is our strength and it pushes us to deliver better solutions for our customers and partners in Hong Kong, Saudi Arabia, and beyond.

Keeta offers limitless career growth and equal development opportunities, empowering you to grow as the company grows. Every day presents an opportunity for you to make a meaningful impact, grow professionally, and be part of something extraordinary. You'll thrive in a dynamic environment where every contribution is valued. Together, let's build the future of food delivery.

title: Assistente de vendas
description:
Você é apaixonada por decoração infantil e adora transformar espaços em ambientes mágicos e cheios de estilo? Se sim, vem trabalhar com a gente!

Somos uma loja de decoração infantil comprometida em tornar os sonhos dos pais e dos pequenos em realidade. Nossa curadoria de produtos é cuidadosa, selecionando produtos para criar ambientes acolhedores, divertidos e inspiradores. Cuidamos do nosso ambiente de trabalho para que seja colaborativo e leve para se trabalhar.

Estamos em busca de uma Consultora de Vendas especializada que seja vibrante e motivada para trabalhar e juntar-se à nossa equipe. A pessoa ideal será apaixonada por decoração infantil, terá excelente habilidade de comunicação, será proativa, e terá a capacidade de transformar o entusiasmo pelo design em boas vendas.

Pré-requisitos:

  • Experiência na área de vendas, de preferência móveis soltos ou planejados.
  • Conhecimento no ScketUp é um diferencial, mas não essencial.
  • Graduação (completa ou em andamento) em Arquitetura, Design de Interiores, Design de Ambientes e/ou áreas afins,
  • Habilidade em vendas, pro-atividade e bom relacionamento interpessoal.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação verbal e escrita.
  • Paixão por design infantil e criatividade.
  • Capacidade de trabalho em equipe.

Responsabilidades:

  • Apoiar a equipe de vendas no atendimento ao cliente com alto astral, proporcionando uma experiência de compra diferenciada.
  • Apoiar a equipe na organização da loja e eficiência do visual merchandising.
  • Dar suporte aos vendedores para realizar vendas via WhatsApp.
  • Apoiar equipe de vendas na prospecções de novos clientes.
  • Acompanhar orçamentos em sistema para conversão.

O que oferecemos:

  • Um ambiente de trabalho dinâmico e criativo.
  • Oportunidades de aprendizado e crescimento profissional com plano de cargos e salário.
  • Descontos especiais em nossos produtos.
  • Salário competitivo.
  • Vale transporte
  • Vale alimentação/refeição
  • Lanche diário
  • Associação ao SESC/SENAC e seus benefícios
  • Convênio com a Evolua (desconto em tarifa energética domiciliar)
  • Descontos em contratações de planos da UNIMED.

Horário de trabalho: Segunda a sexta de 09h às 18h e sábado de 09h às 13h.

Se você está curtiu essa proposta e está pronta para parte de uma equipe dedicada à decoração infantil, venha trabalhar com a gente!
